translations.web: Isn’t the food cut off before our eyes; joy and gladness from the house of our God?
translations.bsb: Has not the food been cut off before our very eyes— joy and gladness from the house of our God?
translations.kjv: Is not the meat cut off before our eyes, yea, joy and gladness from the house of our God?
translations.asv: Is not the food cut off before our eyes, yea, joy and gladness from the house of our God?
